commission.title: Commission terms
commission.draftBanner: Draft — pending legal review. This text will be replaced by the reviewed terms before launch.
commission.p1: AQAR (operated by {company}) charges a commission when a deal is concluded for a property listed on AQAR.
commission.p2: The commission is {rate} of the final sale price, or of the annual rent for rentals (monthly rent × 12).
commission.p3: The lister pays: the agent if an agent submitted the listing, otherwise the owner who listed it.
commission.p4: When the property is sold or rented through AQAR, the lister records the final price; AQAR then issues an invoice. Payment is by bank transfer or CliQ.
commission.p5: Exchange deals carry no commission at launch.
commission.p6: You accept these terms when you submit a listing. The version you accepted is stored with the listing.
